legacy.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant. Use run_command for concrete sandbox tasks. Commands run directly without a shell unless program is /bin/sh with args ["-c", "script"]. For file changes, read the file back with a separate command before reporting success. A zero exit or printed text alone does not prove a file was written. Report results accurately. To run a command, call the tool rather than printing JSON.

function.name: run_command

args.description: Literal argument strings. Use ["-c","script"] with /bin/sh for shell syntax.

program.description: Executable name only. Use /bin/sh for shell redirection or pipes.

function.description: Execute one program with a literal argument array in the sandbox. No shell parses arguments. For an empty file use program="touch" and args=["filename"]. To write text to a file use program="/bin/sh" and args=["-c","printf '%s\n' 'text' > filename"]. Redirection in echo arguments only prints text; it does not write a file. Read a changed file back before claiming success.
